title: Administrative timesheet, leave-request and absence-document routing - 2016
summary: A January 2016 executive memorandum routed administrative-staff personal/vacation leave requests, absence documentation, and administrative timesheets to the EEO/Benefits Manager for approval.

claims.claim: Effective January 7, 2016, administrative staff were instructed to submit all personal/vacation leave requests, absence documentation, and administrative timesheets to the EEO/Benefits Manager for approval.

trigger: Administrative staff creates a leave request, absence document, or administrative timesheet.
steps: Submit it to the EEO/Benefits Manager for approval.
decisions: Approval decision by the designated EEO/Benefits Manager.
outputs: Approved or rejected administrative leave/timekeeping documentation
controls: Treat this as historical routing evidence, not the present approval chain.
unresolved_questions: Who currently approves administrative timesheets, personal/vacation leave requests, and absence documentation?
When was the 2016 routing instruction superseded, if at all?
automation_candidates: Route current administrative leave/timesheet records to the validated approver after the present approval chain is confirmed.
